subject: design/memory-standalone-source-retirement
statement: Extend the existing memory CLI and reconciler with an exact standalone-source retirement seal. Eligible paths are canonical `skills/<slug>/SKILL.md` and `vendor/<slug>/README.md` regular files under Pyxis's vendor-neutral system root, already captured as active literal Documents and owned by no feature. This is an additional evidence type, not a new exemption list or a relaxed feature closeout.
